title: What If You Grew 1% Every Time Someone Lied to You?

lines.t: I love your haircut, Leo.
lines.el: [sweetly] I love your haircut, Leo.

lines.t: Your head hits the ceiling.
lines.el: Your head hits the ceiling.

lines.t: Because starting today... every time someone lies to you, you grow one percent taller.
lines.el: [curious] Because starting today... every time someone lies to you, you grow one percent taller.

lines.t: And your little sister... absolutely hates that haircut.
lines.el: And your little sister... absolutely hates that haircut.

lines.t: Here's the rule. Every lie told to your face, or sent to you, makes you one percent taller. And every hard truth... makes you one percent shorter.
lines.el: Here's the rule. Every lie told to your face, or sent to you, makes you one percent taller. And every hard truth... makes you one percent shorter.

lines.t: You're a hundred and sixty centimeters. The shortest kid in your class.
lines.el: You're a hundred and sixty centimeters. The shortest kid in your class.

lines.t: Scientists think the average person tells about one and a half lies a day. Most of them small. Nice shirt. I'm almost there. I'm fine.
lines.el: Scientists think the average person tells about one and a half lies a day. Most of them small. Nice shirt. I'm almost there. I'm fine.

lines.t: But one percent stacks. Fifty three lies, and you're taller than the tallest man who ever lived.
lines.el: But one percent stacks. Fifty three lies, and you're taller than the tallest man who ever lived.

lines.t: Eight hundred sixty six lies... and you're taller than Mount Everest.
lines.el: Eight hundred sixty six lies... and you're taller than Mount Everest.

lines.t: Day one. Your friend says he's five minutes away. He's still at home. Plus one percent.
lines.el: Day one. Your friend says he's five minutes away. He's still at home. Plus one percent.

lines.t: Your teacher says the test will be easy. Plus one percent.
lines.el: Your teacher says the test will be easy. Plus one percent.

lines.t: By lunch, you're two meters tall. You duck under every door frame. And for the first time in your life... people look up at you.
lines.el: By lunch, you're two meters tall. You duck under every door frame. And for the first time in your life... people look up at you.

lines.t: So you get smart. You start asking questions that people always lie about.
lines.el: [smug] So you get smart. You start asking questions that people always lie about.

lines.t: Your drawing? Uh... it's amazing, man. Really.
lines.el: [nervous] Your drawing? Uh... it's amazing, man. Really.

lines.t: Plus one. Do I look tired? No! Plus one. Is my singing good? Plus one. Plus one. Plus one.
lines.el: Plus one. Do I look tired? No! Plus one. Is my singing good? Plus one. Plus one. Plus one.

lines.t: By Friday, you're two meters seventy. Taller than Robert Wadlow, the tallest man in recorded history.
lines.el: By Friday, you're two meters seventy. Taller than Robert Wadlow, the tallest man in recorded history.

lines.t: You dunk a basketball without jumping. Everyone suddenly laughs at your jokes. Even the terrible ones. Plus one. Plus one. Plus one.
lines.el: [amused] You dunk a basketball without jumping. Everyone suddenly laughs at your jokes. Even the terrible ones. Plus one. Plus one. Plus one.

lines.t: Then the internet finds out.
lines.el: Then the internet finds out.

lines.t: Millions of strangers start sending you lies on purpose. Just to watch you grow. You're the most handsome person alive. You have two hundred I Q. You can fly.
lines.el: [building] Millions of strangers start sending you lies on purpose. Just to watch you grow. You're the most handsome person alive. You have two hundred I Q. You can fly.

lines.t: Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Faster than you can read them.
lines.el: Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Faster than you can read them.

lines.t: By morning, you're as tall as a giraffe. By noon, you can't fit in your house.
lines.el: By morning, you're as tall as a giraffe. By noon, you can't fit in your house.

lines.t: You sleep in the park. Your feet are three streets away from your head.
lines.el: [tense] You sleep in the park. Your feet are three streets away from your head.

lines.t: Day three. Ninety three meters. As tall as the Statue of Liberty. Every step you take sets off car alarms for a mile.
lines.el: Day three. Ninety three meters. As tall as the Statue of Liberty. Every step you take sets off car alarms for a mile.

lines.t: A news helicopter circles your head. The reporter shouts into a megaphone. You look fantastic! Plus one percent.
lines.el: A news helicopter circles your head. The reporter shouts into a megaphone. You look fantastic! Plus one percent.

lines.t: Day five. Nine hundred meters. You're looking down at the top of the tallest building on Earth.
lines.el: Day five. Nine hundred meters. You're looking down at the top of the tallest building on Earth.

lines.t: And up here, it's freezing. The air is thin. Clouds drift past your chest.
lines.el: And up here, it's freezing. The air is thin. Clouds drift past your chest.

lines.t: A passenger jet glides past your ear. The pilot waves. You wave back. Very, very slowly.
lines.el: [awed] A passenger jet glides past your ear. The pilot waves. You wave back. Very, very slowly.

lines.t: Day seven. Nine kilometers. Higher than Mount Everest. Above eight thousand meters, climbers call it the death zone. There isn't enough oxygen to stay alive for long.
lines.el: Day seven. Nine kilometers. Higher than Mount Everest. Above eight thousand meters, climbers call it the death zone. There isn't enough oxygen to stay alive for long.

lines.t: Your head is spinning. Your lips are blue. And the lies just keep coming.
lines.el: [breathless] Your head is spinning. Your lips are blue. And the lies just keep coming.

lines.t: You realize something terrible. If this keeps going... you'll grow until your head is in space.
lines.el: You realize something terrible. If this keeps going... you'll grow until your head is in space.

lines.t: There's only one way down. Someone has to tell you the truth.
lines.el: There's only one way down. Someone has to tell you the truth.

lines.t: But nobody does. Your doctors say you'll be fine. The news says help is on the way. Even your mom says, don't worry, sweetheart. Everything's okay.
lines.el: [frustrated] But nobody does. Your doctors say you'll be fine. The news says help is on the way. Even your mom says, don't worry, sweetheart. Everything's okay.

lines.t: Plus one. Plus one. Plus one. Everyone you love is lying to you... to make you feel better.
lines.el: Plus one. Plus one. Plus one. Everyone you love is lying to you... to make you feel better.

lines.t: And then a tiny voice comes through the phone in your ear.
lines.el: [quietly] And then a tiny voice comes through the phone in your ear.

lines.t: Leo. It's Mia. I'm going to tell you the truth. All of it.
lines.el: [serious] Leo. It's Mia. I'm going to tell you the truth. All of it.

lines.t: You've been a bad brother since you got tall. You stopped coming to my games. You only talk to people who lie to you.
lines.el: [shaky] You've been a bad brother since you got tall. You stopped coming to my games. You only talk to people who lie to you.

lines.t: Minus one percent. Minus one percent. It hurts more than the cold.
lines.el: Minus one percent. Minus one percent. It hurts more than the cold.

lines.t: And I hate your haircut. I always did. And I don't care how tall you are. I just want my brother back.
lines.el: [crying] And I hate your haircut. I always did. And I don't care how tall you are. I just want my brother back.

lines.t: And Leo... I'm scared. I've been scared every single day. I'm sorry I lied to you.
lines.el: [crying] And Leo... I'm scared. I've been scared every single day. I'm sorry I lied to you.

lines.t: Minus one percent. Your mom's truth hits harder than anything.
lines.el: Minus one percent. Your mom's truth hits harder than anything.

lines.t: Every truth pulls you closer to the ground. Clouds. Rooftops. Trees.
lines.el: [emotional] Every truth pulls you closer to the ground. Clouds. Rooftops. Trees.

lines.t: For a whole night, she doesn't lie to you once. Not even to be nice.
lines.el: For a whole night, she doesn't lie to you once. Not even to be nice.

lines.t: When the sun comes up, you're a hundred and sixty centimeters again. Shortest kid in the class.
lines.el: When the sun comes up, you're a hundred and sixty centimeters again. Shortest kid in the class.

lines.t: And for the first time, you understand. The people who tell you nice lies are the ones who want you to feel good.
lines.el: And for the first time, you understand. The people who tell you nice lies are the ones who want you to feel good.

lines.t: The ones who tell you the truth... are the ones who want you to stay.
lines.el: [softly] The ones who tell you the truth... are the ones who want you to stay.

lines.t: Also, I didn't eat your last cookie.
lines.el: [smiling] Also, I didn't eat your last cookie.

lines.t: Plus one percent.
lines.el: [pause] Plus one percent.

lines.t: Who in your life always tells you the truth? Tag them in the comments.
lines.el: Who in your life always tells you the truth? Tag them in the comments.
